title: What Budget Wedding Guide Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of budget wedding guide: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
A beautiful wedding does not require a fortune: the US median wedding costs around $30,000, but smart couples celebrate well for $5,000-$10,000 by prioritizing venue, food, and photography.

Why it matters: Venue + catering = 40-50% of most wedding budgets Off-season (Jan-Mar) and Friday/Sunday dates cut venue costs 20-40%

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.
facts: A beautiful wedding does not require a fortune: the US median wedding costs around $30,000, but smart couples celebrate well for $5,000-$10,000 by prioritizing venue, food, and photography.
Venue + catering = 40-50% of most wedding budgets
Off-season (Jan-Mar) and Friday/Sunday dates cut venue costs 20-40%
Guest count is the biggest cost lever: each guest adds $75-$200
A 50-guest wedding can cost under $8,000 total

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Budget Wedding Guide
summary: Start budget wedding guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Set the total budget first - and a 10% buffer
2. Pick guest count before venue
3. Book venue, then caterer, then photographer
4. Choose 3 must-haves; economize on the rest
5. Send save-the-dates 6-8 months out

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

Pick guest count before venue
Book venue, then caterer, then photographer

title: Budget Wedding Guide Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common budget wedding guide questions.
body:
Q: How much should we spend?
A: Whatever you can pay without debt - many couples stay under $10k.

Q: Cash bar or open bar?
A: Beer/wine/signature cocktail keeps costs sane.

Q: Do we need a wedding planner?
A: A day-of coordinator ($500-$1,500) is the best value.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
